The OPENLAB architects is a multidisciplinary laboratory for the development of ideas in the fields of architecture, interiors and design that offers support to its customers from the initial conception to the final execution of the projects. The practice got an award from World Architecture Awards, was published internationally and was invited for the conference cycle ‘Jovens arquitectos premiados internacionalmente’ a joint initiative of the Portuguese Architects Order and MUDE, the Lisbon based Museum of Design and Fashion.
